blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After two straight weeks of oil price increases, gasoline prices will roll back by at least P4.30 per liter and kerosene by P1 per liter on Tuesday, while diesel prices will rise by P2.60 per liter. The Department of Energy (DOE) said the adjustments reflect movements in the global oil market amid developments in the Middle East that continue to affect supply and prices.
